utils.drive_client module¶

Google Drive client — file listing, download, and DataFrame loading.

utils.drive_client.download_drive_file(credentials: Credentials, file_id: str, mime_type: str) → BytesIO[source]¶

Download a Drive file as CSV bytes.

  • text/csv: direct download.

  • application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet: export as CSV via Drive export API.

utils.drive_client.list_drive_files(credentials: Credentials, mime_types: list[str], page_size: int = 50) → list[dict[str, str]][source]¶

List files in the user’s Drive matching given MIME types.

Parameters:

  • credentials – OAuth credentials from st.session_state.ga4_creds.

  • mime_types – e.g., [“text/csv”, “application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet”].

  • page_size – Max files to return.

Returns:

“…”, “name”: “…”, “mime_type”: “…”}, …]

Return type:

[{“id”

utils.drive_client.load_drive_file_as_df(credentials: Credentials, file_id: str, mime_type: str) → tuple[DataFrame | None, str | None][source]¶

Download a Drive file and load it as a pandas DataFrame.

Enforces same limits as load_file(): MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB (100MB), MAX_ROWS (50k). Returns (df, None) on success or (None, error_message) on failure. Matches the signature of load_file() in utils/data_loader.py.
